text: startVerification constructs a promise by registering VerifierEvent.ShowSas, then calls verify and awaits the event. It checks cancelled state before interpreting the challenge and supports emoji or decimal representations. A scoped async recommendation is to retain listener-before-action ordering when refactoring this SDK adapter; waiting only after verify could miss an event.
